findings.summary: In strict mode, assert.equal is strictEqual, which compares with Object.is rather than ===.
findings.evidence: Import node:assert/strict: equal is then ===, deepEqual is strict deep equality
findings.fix: Write: equal is then strictEqual (Object.is semantics, so NaN equals NaN and +0 differs from -0), and deepEqual is deepStrictEqual.
